notes.title: DEMO UPDATE
notes.content: [list][*][p][b]New Loadout System[/b]: Players can now customize their equipment before entering gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gamepad Support (W.I.P.)[/b]: Initial implementation of controller support; full compatibility is in progress.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Weapons[/b]: Additional weapons have been added to expand combat variety.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Ambience[/b]: Improved environmental audio and visual effects for better immersion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]AI System Enhancements[/b]: Enemy behavior has been refined for more dynamic and challenging encounters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quest System Improvements[/b]: Quest flow and tracking have been optimized for better clarity and usability.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spawn System Tweaks[/b]: Adjustments made to ensure more balanced enemy spawns.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b]: Various reported issues have been resolved to improve overall performance.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for playing and providing feedback. Your input helps us shape the future of the game.[/p]

tags.feature: [b]New Loadout System[/b]: Players can now customize their equipment before entering gameplay.
[b]Gamepad Support (W.I.P.)[/b]: Initial implementation of controller support; full compatibility is in progress.
[b]New Weapons[/b]: Additional weapons have been added to expand combat variety.
[b]New Ambience[/b]: Improved environmental audio and visual effects for better immersion.
[b]AI System Enhancements[/b]: Enemy behavior has been refined for more dynamic and challenging encounters.
[b]Quest System Improvements[/b]: Quest flow and tracking have been optimized for better clarity and usability.

tags.balance_change: [b]Spawn System Tweaks[/b]: Adjustments made to ensure more balanced enemy spawns.

tags.bug: [b]Bug Fixes[/b]: Various reported issues have been resolved to improve overall performance.
